name: Window Management
description: Move, resize and snap windows across screens; get frontmost app, list open windows, manage displays and spaces. Windows are addressed by stable handles (get_windows and new_window return one per window) rather than by a z-order index that shifts as windows are focused, and the live window list is a subscribable resource. Also ships an app-switcher across three Stream Deck surfaces — a key (press cycles apps), a dial (rotate to preview, press to switch), and a popup grid — as live MCP App UI resources with in-component handlers.
